question: Should the dashboard-design workflow live as a ClawHub skill that consumes a dashboard/preview screenshot API, or should OpenClaw bundle it with the dashboard plugin?
rationale: VISION.md prefers new skills through ClawHub, but this request also needs a security-sensitive dashboard screenshot capability that likely belongs in the dashboard/preview implementation.

options.title: ClawHub Skill After Screenshot API
options.body: Keep core work limited to a scoped dashboard/preview screenshot API and ask the workflow package to ship through ClawHub once that API is stable.

options.title: Bundle With Dashboard Plugin
options.body: Sponsor the skill as official bundled dashboard behavior and require explicit product ownership, security review, and end-to-end proof before landing it.

options.title: Defer Until Dashboard Stack Lands
options.body: Leave this leaf item parked until the Wave 1 dashboard stack and preview-widget direction are settled.

recommendation.title: ClawHub Skill After Screenshot API
recommendation.body: Keep core work limited to a scoped dashboard/preview screenshot API and ask the workflow package to ship through ClawHub once that API is stable.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest merged current-main ownership signal for the plugin-tab Control UI seam this roadmap builds on.
